questions.question: Where was the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association founded in 1928?
questions.solution:
• HSRA Founding Place: Delhi
  • Detail: Founded at Feroz Shah Kotla by Chandrashekhar Azad and Bhagat Singh.

questions.question: What is the source of Directive Principles of State Policy?
questions.option_1: The instrument of instructions from GOI Act 1947
questions.option_2: The instrument of instructions from GOI Act 1909
questions.option_3: The instrument of instructions from GOI Act 1935
questions.option_4: The instrument of instructions from GOI Act 1919
questions.solution:
• DPSP Source: The instrument of instructions from GOI Act 1935
  • Fact: Our Constitution makers borrowed the concept of DPSP from the Irish Constitution.

questions.question: Who is regarded as the ‘Mother of Indian Revolution’?
questions.solution:
• Mother of Indian Revolution: Madame Cama
  • Action: She unfurled the first version of the Indian flag at Stuttgart, Germany, in 1907.

questions.question: Who among the following reformers initially set up a school for girls in Calcutta?
questions.solution:
• School for Girls (Calcutta): Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar
  • Role: He was instrumental in establishing numerous schools for girls in Bengal.

questions.question: Which religion has the maximum number of followers in Bhutan?
questions.solution:
• Bhutan Religion: Buddhism
  • Branch: Vajrayana Buddhism is the state religion.

questions.question: Bharhut Stupa is located in which of the following states?
questions.solution:
• Bharhut Stupa: Madhya Pradesh
  • History: Famous for its railings and gateways that depict Buddhist legends.

questions.question: When did the British East India Company start the ‘permanent settlement system’?
questions.solution:
• Permanent Settlement: 1793 CE
  • Governor-General: Lord Cornwallis.

questions.question: The word ‘Swaraj’ was first used by Dadabhai Naoroji in the Congress session held in which place?
questions.solution:
• Swaraj Word Usage: Calcutta
  • 1906: Dadabhai Naoroji presided over this session where the demand for Swaraj was first made from the INC platform.

questions.question: Who among the following designed the India Gate?
questions.solution:
• India Gate Designer: Edwin Lutyens
  • Note: It was built as a memorial to Indian soldiers who died in World War I.

questions.question: Who founded the Hindu reform organisation Brahmo Samaj?
questions.solution:
• Brahmo Samaj Founder: Raja Ram Mohan Roy
  • Context: Established to fight social evils like Sati and the caste system.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a Directive Principle based on the ideals of Mahatma Gandhi?
questions.option_1: To prohibit intoxicating drinks and drugs that are injurious to health
questions.option_2: To promote cottage industries in rural areas
questions.option_4: To promote industrialisation in urban areas
questions.solution:
• Non-Gandhian DPSP: To promote industrialisation in urban areas
  • Fact: Promotion of cottage industries (rural) is a Gandhian ideal; large-scale industrialization is not.

questions.question: Which Indian Mass Movement began with the famous ‘Dandi March’ of Mahatma Gandhi?
questions.solution:
• Civil Disobedience: Civil Disobedience Movement
  • 1930: Triggered by the breach of the Salt Law at Dandi.

questions.question: The foundation of Sanchi Stupa was laid by which of the following Kings?
questions.solution:
• Sanchi Stupa Founder: Ashoka
  • Period: Maurya Empire.

questions.question: Ajmer Sharif is the shrine of which of the following Sufi saints?
questions.solution:
• Ajmer Sharif: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti
  • Order: He was the founder of the Chishtiya order of Sufism in India.

questions.question: In which year were the Arms Act and Vernacular Press Act passed?
questions.solution:
• 1878 Acts: 1878
  • Viceroy: Lord Lytton passed both the Vernacular Press Act and the Indian Arms Act.

questions.question: Who was the first Woman President of Indian National Congress?
questions.solution:
• First Woman INC President: Annie Besant
  • 1917: Presided over the Calcutta session. (Note: Sarojini Naidu was the first *Indian* woman president in 1925).

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about the huge bathrooms of the Indus Valley Civilization?
questions.option_2: It was used as the city's water tank.
questions.option_3: It was used for storing grains.
questions.option_4: It was probably used for religious purposes.
questions.solution:
• IVC Great Bath: It was probably used for religious purposes.
  • Archaeology: The Great Bath of Mohenjo-daro suggests ritualistic cleansing.

questions.question: In which year was the Vernacular Press Act passed?
questions.solution:
• Vernacular Press Act Year: 1878 AD
  • Target: To silence Indian language newspapers that were critical of British policies.

questions.question: Who among the following was the founder of the Khudai Khidmatgars, a powerful non-violent movement among the Pathans of North-West Frontier Province?
questions.solution:
• Khudai Khidmatgars: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan
  • Nickname: Known as 'Frontier Gandhi'. His followers wore red shirts (Red Shirt Movement).

questions.question: Who moved the resolution proposing that the National Flag of India be a ‘horizontal tricolour of saffron, white and dark green in equal proportion’?
questions.solution:
• National Flag Proposer: Jawaharlal Nehru
  • 1947: Nehru moved the resolution in the Constituent Assembly.

questions.question: Which of the following Indus Valley sites is now located in Pakistan?
questions.solution:
• Harappa: Harappa
  • Geography: Located on the banks of the Ravi River in Punjab, Pakistan.

questions.question: Who among the following was the viceroy of India at the time of India’s independence from colonial rule on 15 August 1947?
questions.solution:
• Independence Viceroy: Lord Mountbatten
  • History: He was the last Viceroy of British India and the first Governor-General of independent India.

questions.question: Where was Shree Narayana Dharma Paripalana Yogam founded?
questions.solution:
• SNDP Yogam: Kerala
  • Founder: Shree Narayana Guru, who campaigned against the caste system.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about Mahatma Gandhi is INCORRECT?
questions.option_1: He led the Dandi Salt March in 1930.
questions.option_2: Mahatma Gandhi was born in 1869 in Porbandar.
questions.option_3: He led the Champaran Satyagraha in 1910.
questions.option_4: In 1942, he launched the Quit India Movement.
questions.solution:
• Incorrect Gandhi Fact: He led the Champaran Satyagraha in 1910.
  • Correction: The Champaran Satyagraha took place in **1917**, which was Gandhi's first major movement in India.

questions.question: In which of the following years was the Child Marriage Restraint Act passed?
questions.solution:
• Sarda Act: 1929
  • Detail: The Child Marriage Restraint Act fixed the age of marriage for girls at 14 and boys at 18.
